sentences.en: And because natural gas has almost doubled in some cases, that has made it unprofitable for some fertilizer plants to produce.
sentences.zh: 欧洲，我们在过去一个月看到许多大型化肥厂正在限制产能或完全关闭。

sentences.en: And so across
sentences.zh: 而且由于冬奥会前夕，中国一直在削减化肥产量，我们已经面临化肥供应紧张的问题。

sentences.en: Europe, what we've seen over the past month is many major fertilizer plants are restricting capacity or shutting down altogether.
sentences.zh: 这是因为许多中国大型化肥厂是燃煤的，会产生大量污染。

sentences.en: And we already had a squeeze in the supply of fertilizer because ahead of the Winter Olympics, China was curtailing its production of fertilizer.
sentences.zh: 作为他们在奥运会前减少污染的政策的一部分，他们削减了产量。

sentences.en: And that's because many major Chinese fertilizer plants are coal-fired, which produce a lot of pollution.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们现在本质上陷入了一场化肥危机。

sentences.en: And as part of their sky policy to reduce pollution ahead of the Olympics, they cut production.
sentences.zh: 这正威胁着加剧已经成为粮食危机的局面。

sentences.en: So as a result, what we essentially have is a fertilizer crisis.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that is threatening to worsen what is already becoming a crisis in food.
sentences.zh: 因为正如你所说，应对粮食危机的办法是种植更多的粮食，但如果你没有化肥，你就无法种植那么多粮食。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一场深度自我强化的危机。

sentences.en: Because as you said, the answer to a food crisis is planting more food, but you can't plant all that more food if you don't have the fertilizer.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: So this is a deeply self-reinforcing crisis.
sentences.zh: 经济学家和官员们担心的是，高昂的化肥价格将导致农民减少化肥的使用。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 而更少的化肥意味着更差的收成。

sentences.en: And what economists and officials are worried about is that the high fertilizer prices are going to cause farmers to apply less fertilizer.
sentences.zh: 产量更少、尺寸更小、蛋白质含量更低的作物。

sentences.en: And less fertilizer means worse crops.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们面临的现实。

sentences.en: Crops that are less in quantity, less in size, lower protein.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你，杰克。

sentences.en: And when you have, let's say, corn and soybean, for example, you know, crops that are often fed to animals,
sentences.zh: 比如，当你拥有玉米和大豆这类通常用作动物饲料的作物时，

sentences.en: when they have less protein, we're going to have skinnier cattle, skinnier hogs.
sentences.zh: 如果它们的蛋白质含量降低，我们就会得到更瘦的牛和更瘦的猪。

sentences.en: And that means higher meat prices.
sentences.zh: 这意味着肉类价格会上涨。

sentences.en: So there are all sorts of cascading effects.
sentences.zh: 所以这会产生各种连锁反应。

sentences.en: And this is already playing out.
sentences.zh: 而且这种情况已经在发生了。

sentences.en: So for example, I spoke to a farmer in South Texas, and he told me that because of high fertilizer prices, he's already stopped applying fertilizer to his pastures.
sentences.zh: 举个例子，我采访了南得克萨斯州的一位农民，他告诉我，由于化肥价格高昂，他已经停止在牧场施肥了。

sentences.en: And what that means is the hundreds of cows that graze there are likely going to end up skinnier come slaughter.
sentences.zh: 这意味着在那里吃草的数百头牛在屠宰时可能会变得更瘦。

sentences.en: And that means he'll have less meat to sell.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他能卖的肉会变少。

sentences.en: And less supply means higher prices.
sentences.zh: 供应减少意味着价格上涨。

sentences.en: And when this plays out across the world, it means that fertilizer could end up resulting in even higher and higher prices.
sentences.zh: 当这种情况在全球范围内上演时，意味着化肥问题最终可能导致价格越来越高。

sentences.en: So just to step back and put all this together, we begin with wheat locked up in Ukraine and Russia that can't reach many countries that rely so heavily on it.
sentences.zh: 退一步总结一下，我们从被困在乌克兰和俄罗斯的小麦开始，这些小麦无法到达许多极度依赖它们的国家。

sentences.en: As a result, their wheat prices are higher.
sentences.zh: 结果就是，它们的小麦价格上涨了。

sentences.en: And then we get fertilizer, which could help solve the problem.
sentences.zh: 然后是化肥，它本可以帮助解决这个问题。

sentences.en: But it's locked there.
sentences.zh: 但它被困在那里了。

sentences.en: So prices for that go through the roof.
sentences.zh: 所以化肥价格飞涨。

sentences.en: And when you put those two things together, every element of the global food supply is more expensive, which in a place like the United States is a matter of higher prices at the
sentences.zh: 当你把这两件事放在一起看，全球食品供应的每一个环节都变得更贵了，这在美国这样的地方表现为

sentences.en: checkout line.
sentences.zh: 结账时的价格上涨。

sentences.en: And it sounds like in a place like Yemen, very quickly becomes a matter of life and death.
sentences.zh: 而在也门这样的地方，很快就变成了生死攸关的问题。

sentences.en: So I think it's important to remember that when food prices go up, it disproportionately hurts the poor.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为必须记住，当食品价格上涨时，受打击最严重的是穷人。

sentences.en: So even in the US, if you're poor, you don't have a choice.
sentences.zh: 所以即使在美国，如果你很穷，你也没有选择。

sentences.en: You buy food.
sentences.zh: 你必须买食物。

sentences.en: And when food is more expensive, you know, you cut back on other things, including maybe things like healthcare or education.
sentences.zh: 当食物变贵时，你知道，你就会削减其他开支，可能包括医疗或教育等方面的支出。

sentences.en: Now in wealthier countries, there are going to be safety nets that are going to prevent this sort of hunger that we're seeing increase in other parts of the world.
sentences.zh: 在较富裕的国家，会有安全网来防止我们在世界其他地区看到的这种饥饿现象加剧。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But there are other ripple effects.
sentences.zh: 但还有其他连锁反应。

sentences.en: So for instance, there are studies that show clear links between political and social upheaval and rising food prices.
sentences.zh: 例如，有研究表明政治和社会动荡与食品价格上涨之间存在明确的联系。

sentences.en: And in fact, the Arab Spring was in part sparked by high food prices.
sentences.zh: 事实上，“阿拉伯之春”在一定程度上就是由高昂的食品价格引发的。

sentences.en: And already in Tunisia and Egypt, we're seeing signs of unrest because of the cost of food.
sentences.zh: 而在突尼斯和埃及，我们已经看到了因食品成本而引发动荡的迹象。

sentences.en: So this really could have much larger ramifications all over the globe.
sentences.zh: 所以这确实可能在全球范围内产生更大的影响。

sentences.en: So it feels like the solution to everything we're talking about here is for the war to come to an end, that that that would alleviate most of it.
sentences.zh: 所以感觉我们在这里讨论的所有问题的解决方案就是战争结束，那将缓解大部分问题。

sentences.en: It would certainly help a great deal.
sentences.zh: 那肯定会有很大帮助。

sentences.en: But even then, a solution will take time.
sentences.zh: 但即便如此，解决方案也需要时间。

sentences.en: So the World Food
sentences.zh: 世界粮食

sentences.en: Program says that even if the war stops tomorrow, they believe the food market will take six to nine months to fully recover.
sentences.zh: 计划署表示，即使战争明天停止，他们认为食品市场也需要六到九个月才能完全恢复。

sentences.en: And what we also know is politically, it's unlikely that sanctions would disappear with the end of a war.
sentences.zh: 而且我们也知道，在政治上，制裁不太可能随着战争的结束而消失。

sentences.en: And so a lot of the issues related to fertilizer and high energy prices likely would still persiSt. So what you're describing is now locked into the global food
sentences.zh: 因此，许多与化肥和高能源价格相关的问题很可能仍然存在。所以你所描述的现在已经锁定在全球食品

sentences.en: supply for what sounds like almost a year, if the war were to come to an end, which it hasn't.
sentences.zh: 供应中，如果战争结束的话，听起来几乎要持续一年，而战争并没有结束。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And if the war drags on, there's something else to be really worried about.
sentences.zh: 如果战争拖延下去，还有一件非常令人担忧的事情。

sentences.en: And that's the next crop in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 那就是乌克兰的下一季作物。

sentences.en: So the world already is essentially going to go without a lot of the current year crop.
sentences.zh: 世界基本上已经要失去今年很大一部分作物了。

sentences.en: But the Ukrainian wheat has been planted, and there now are concerns about the ability to harvest it and the ability to plant the next crop.
sentences.zh: 但乌克兰的小麦已经种下，现在人们担心的是收获它的能力以及种植下一季作物的能力。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that could last a lot longer than nine months or 12 months.
sentences.zh: 那可能会持续比九个月或十二个月更长的时间。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 正确。

sentences.en: That means that this food crisis would drag on for potentially, you know, more than a year or two.
sentences.zh: 这意味着这场粮食危机可能会拖延，你知道，超过一两年。

sentences.en: And Jack, when you talk to people in Brazil, where we started this conversation,
sentences.zh: 杰克，当你和巴西的人们交谈时，也就是我们开始这次对话的地方，

sentences.en: what do they say about all this?
sentences.zh: 他们对此怎么说？

sentences.en: And how acutely now are they feeling it?
sentences.zh: 他们现在感受到的有多强烈？

sentences.en: So here in Brazil, there is actually more frustration with the sanctions in many cases than the war itself, because they want to get fertilizer from Russia.
sentences.zh: 在巴西，实际上在很多情况下，人们对制裁的挫败感比对战争本身的挫败感更强，因为他们想从俄罗斯获得化肥。

sentences.en: And in fact, what we're now seeing in these later weeks of the war is that Brazilian agriculture companies seem to be starting to
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们在战争后期的几周里看到的是，巴西农业公司似乎开始

sentences.en: figure out how to get fertilizer out of Russia, getting around sanctions.
sentences.zh: 想办法从俄罗斯获取化肥，绕过制裁。

sentences.en: And so that may be good news for food, but it also spells bad news for the political realities of the war and diplomacy.
sentences.zh: 这对粮食来说可能是个好消息，但对战争和外交的政治现实来说却是个坏消息。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because the point of those sanctions is to keep countries from doing trade with Russia.
sentences.zh: 因为这些制裁的目的是阻止各国与俄罗斯进行贸易。

sentences.en: And it sounds like what you're saying is that frustration in Brazil over the impacts of those sanctions is now
sentences.zh: 听起来你的意思是，巴西对这些制裁影响的挫败感现在

sentences.en: running so high that people just want to work around them, which is not a good sign for all the countries trying to hold Russia accountable for this war.
sentences.zh: 高涨到人们只想绕过它们，这对所有试图让俄罗斯为这场战争负责的国家来说不是一个好迹象。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And in fact, from the beginning, there has been a really tricky question about sanctions on Russia, because as we've already discussed, Russia is such an important producer
sentences.zh: 事实上，从一开始，关于对俄制裁就有一个非常棘手的问题，因为正如我们已经讨论过的，俄罗斯是如此重要的

sentences.en: of food and fertilizer.
sentences.zh: 粮食和化肥生产国。

sentences.en: So it does raise an important question that as the war drags on and as the food crisis becomes worse, does it shift anger?
sentences.zh: 所以这确实提出了一个重要问题：随着战争拖延和粮食危机恶化，这会转移愤怒吗？

sentences.en: Does it shift sentiment against the sanctions and against the West's response to the war in a way that could meaningfully impact their ability to try to combat
sentences.zh: 这会改变对制裁和西方对战争反应的情绪，从而以一种可能产生重大影响的方式影响他们试图在外交上打击

sentences.en: the war diplomatically with sanctions?
sentences.zh: 战争的能力吗？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because if people are asked to choose between punishing Russia for invading Ukraine and their next meal, it doesn't seem like there's going to be a huge debate.
sentences.zh: 因为如果人们被要求在惩罚俄罗斯入侵乌克兰和下一顿饭之间做出选择，似乎不会有太大的争论。

sentences.en: They're going to choose their next meal.
sentences.zh: 他们会选择下一顿饭。

sentences.en: So I think much of the world wants to stand with Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为世界上大部分地区都想与乌克兰站在一起。

sentences.en: They want to punish Russia.
sentences.zh: 他们想惩罚俄罗斯。

sentences.en: They want to show that it's not okay to invade another country.
sentences.zh: 他们想表明入侵另一个国家是不对的。

sentences.en: But I think how some countries like Brazil are responding to this moral dilemma is a sign of what countries will do when food is at stake.
sentences.zh: 但我认为像巴西这样的一些国家如何应对这种道德困境，是当粮食受到威胁时各国会怎么做的一个信号。

sentences.en: We've seen a number of countries start to implement export restrictions.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到一些国家开始实施出口限制。

sentences.en: So Turkey, Hungary, Indonesia, Argentina, have all made it more difficult to send out food since the war began because of their concerns.
sentences.zh: 所以土耳其、匈牙利、印度尼西亚、阿根廷，自战争开始以来，由于他们的担忧，都增加了运出粮食的难度。

sentences.en: Essentially, they're hoarding the food they have.
sentences.zh: 本质上，他们是在囤积现有的粮食。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So that means that whether it's getting around sanctions or this hoarding of food, I think
sentences.zh: 所以这意味着，无论是绕过制裁还是囤积粮食，我认为

sentences.en: what this war and the efforts to punish Russia are showing is that disrupting the global food supply
sentences.zh: 这场战争和惩罚俄罗斯的努力所表明的是，破坏全球粮食供应

sentences.en: has really profound consequences because countries will do really unexpected things when you threaten their ability to feed their people.
sentences.zh: 确实会产生深远的后果，因为当你威胁到各国养活人民的能力时，他们会做出非常意想不到的事情。

sentences.en: Well, Jack, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，杰克，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to another day.
sentences.zh: 以下是你还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Monday, global outrage intensified over what appeared to be Russia's execution of civilians
sentences.zh: 周一，全球对俄罗斯在乌克兰布查镇似乎处决平民的行为感到愤怒，

sentences.en: in the Ukrainian town of Bucha, prompting several leaders, including President Biden, to describe them as war crimes and to call Vladimir Putin a war criminal.
sentences.zh: 这促使包括拜登总统在内的几位领导人将其描述为战争罪，并称弗拉基米尔·普京为战犯。

sentences.en: This guy is brutal.
sentences.zh: 这家伙太残暴了。

sentences.en: And what's happening in Bucha is outrageous.
sentences.zh: 布查发生的事情令人发指。

sentences.en: And everyone's seen it.
sentences.zh: 每个人都看到了。

sentences.en: Images from Bucha, taken in the days after Russian troops withdrew from the town, showed scores of dead civilians, some with their hands tied, others buried in pits.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯军队撤出布查镇后几天拍摄的图像显示，有大量平民死亡，一些人双手被绑，另一些人被埋在坑里。

sentences.en: In response, Germany and France expelled
sentences.zh: 作为回应，德国和法国驱逐了

sentences.en: 75 Russian diplomats, and European leaders called for tough new sanctions against Russia, including on its oil and coal industries.
sentences.zh: 75名俄罗斯外交官，欧洲领导人呼吁对俄罗斯实施严厉的新制裁，包括针对其石油和煤炭行业。

sentences.en: In Moscow, Russian officials denied any role in the civilian deaths, threatened to prosecute anyone who publicly blamed Russia for the killings, and claimed that the
sentences.zh: 在莫斯科，俄罗斯官员否认在平民死亡事件中扮演任何角色，威胁要起诉任何公开指责俄罗斯杀戮的人，并声称

sentences.en: bodies had been placed in Bucha after Russian forces had left.
sentences.zh: 尸体是在俄军离开后被放置在布查的。

sentences.en: But a review of videos and satellite imagery by the New York Times shows that many of the civilians
sentences.zh: 但《纽约时报》对视频和卫星图像的审查显示，许多平民

sentences.en: were killed more than three weeks ago, when Russia's military was still in control of the town.
sentences.zh: 是在三周多前被杀害的，当时俄罗斯军队仍控制着该镇。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由Asla Chaturvedi、Rob Zipko和Rachel Quester制作，并得到了

sentences.zh: Michael Simon Johnson的帮助。

sentences.zh: 由Liz O'Balen剪辑，包含Chelsea Daniel、

sentences.zh: Dan Powell和Marion Lozano的原创音乐，并由Chris Wood进行工程处理。

sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的Jim Brunberg和Ben Landberg创作。

sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.zh: 本周在《Wirecutter秀》上，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人感到宾至如归的建议。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全黑暗才能睡觉的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何地方收听《Wirecutter秀》。
